why: Inside a class folder's method file, a call of the file's own name on an object of another class runs MATLAB's function (MATLAB R2026a: `size(w)` in `@Qa/size.m` on another class's object runs MATLAB's `size`): `k = numel(k)` in `@Gizmo/numel.m` with `k` a Widget is MATLAB's `numel`, a double (no `numel` in `@Widget/`), so `tidy(k)` is the root `tidy.m`.
